preconditions.description: The number of boxes n is between 2 and 10^5 inclusive.
The index of the box that got the last ball x is between 1 and n inclusive.
The number of elements in the list a is equal to n.

preconditions.expression: all(0 <= a_i <= 10**9 for a_i in a)
preconditions.description: Each element in the list a is between 0 and 10^9 inclusive.
The box at index x has at least one ball after Vasya's actions.

postconditions.description: The output list has n elements.

postconditions.expression: all(0 <= b_i <= 10**9 for b_i in return_value)
postconditions.description: Each element in the output list is between 0 and 10^9 inclusive.
The box at index x has at least one ball in the initial arrangement.

postconditions.expression: all(isinstance(b_i, int) for b_i in return_value)
postconditions.description: Each element in the output list is an integer.
The total number of balls in the initial arrangement is equal to the total number of balls in the final arrangement.
